description: Multi-model code review. Pass a diff and get structured findings with severity, file/line references, and a verdict (approve / approve with warnings / needs changes). Multiple models review independently, then findings are synthesized and deduplicated. Use this for PR reviews, code audits, or pre-commit checks.

description.description: Optional: PR description or commit message

diff.description: The unified diff to review (e.g., output of `git diff`)

focus.description: Optional: focus areas for the review. Default: all categories.

instructions.description: Optional: repo-specific review instructions (e.g., 'we use strict null checks', 'focus on SQL injection risks')

models.description: Optional: specific models as 'provider:model'. Default: all configured providers.

title.description: Optional: PR title or change summary for context

name: brainstorm_review
